name: airbattery-mcp
description: Let AI agents query device battery levels via AirBattery
long_description: A read-only MCP server that lets AI agents query battery levels for devices AirBattery already tracks on this Mac (AirPods, iPhone, Bluetooth mice, headphones, speakers). It exposes a standard MCP tool over stdio for compatible clients, including Codex and Claude. It has no Bluetooth permission of its own: it calls AirBattery's command line tool and reports the latest readings AirBattery has detected. Requires AirBattery (https://github.com/lihaoyun6/AirBattery) to be installed and running.

tools.name: get_battery_status
tools.description: Get current battery levels of the user's devices, as reported by AirBattery
